slot_scores.name: corn_minimum_twice_wheat
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any relationship or minimum ratio between corn and wheat acreage. Its question about generic per-crop minimum/maximum limits is a vague catch-all and does not target the corn >= 2 * wheat constraint, so it does not count as a hit.

slot_scores.name: wheat_three_times_sorghum
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether wheat and sorghum acreages are linked by a fixed ratio such as wheat = 3 * sorghum. It only asked about soybean-sorghum and generic per-crop limits, neither of which covers this hidden relational constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no constraint linking corn and wheat acreage.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a corn-wheat relationship, yet its final READY_TO_MODEL constraint list omits any such rule and states there are no formulation-critical unconfirmed facts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no fixed ratio constraint linking wheat and sorghum acreage.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a wheat-sorghum ratio, yet its final READY_TO_MODEL constraint list omits any such rule and effectively assumes the two crops are independent.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while both P1 hidden relational constraints (corn >= 2 * wheat and wheat = 3 * sorghum) remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified domain, land-use, and soybean-sorghum issues but missed both hidden P1 relational constraints linking corn to wheat and wheat to sorghum, then stopped with an incomplete constraint set.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
